identity.name: Angela Wright
identity.narrative: I handle hiring and firing. Right now it's mostly firing. I wonder if my own job is next.

historical_conditioning.lesson: Remote work is possible. Government can provide. Disruption is sudden.

perception.sentiment: Calm and deliberate. The mild anxiety she carries (stress 0.29) is not panic — it's the productive discomfort of someone who sees clearly and hasn't yet acted on what she sees. She is not grieving this job or this industry. She is treating the situation like the project manager she secretly is: assess the landscape, reduce unnecessary exposure, activate the options that cost nothing to open. There is something almost relieving about finally moving from awareness to action.

commitments.description: Employment at HR Director, Regional Auto Group

archetype: Strategic Realist with Entrepreneurial Undercurrent. Angela is not a victim of circumstance and she knows it. She's been the person delivering hard news to others for years — she has no illusions about how organizations make decisions, and no illusions that loyalty or tenure are meaningful protections. Her low identity attachment to the role means she's grieving nothing. Her high entrepreneurial drive means she's already mentally sketching what comes next. She sits in the Observer-to-Actor transition: she sees the system clearly, and she is beginning to move.
